bio: After a 24-year Navy career, Jim Downing has served on staff with The Navigators for 27 years in many capacities, including Deputy President and Chairman of the Board of Directors. Morena Downing, Jim's wife of 68 years, went home to be with the Lord in February, 2010. Jim maintains a heavy speaking schedule as he ministers throughout The Navigator ministries. From Jim you will learn how to abide in the Word of God, apply it to your own life, and move on to maturity as a laborer for Jesus Christ.
